A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the purine phosphotransferase activity in developing rat brain was considerably less than that of liver, but that the activity of the enzyme increased with age.
the activity of the purine salvage reactions in brain was similar to or higher than that in liver, and was higher than in kidney and heart.
the activity of the purine phospho ribosyltransferases was much higher in liver than brain tissue and the activity of amidophospho ribosyl transferase was much higher in brain than in liver.

the activity of these enzymes is very low in the developing brain and is only slightly increased in the adult brain.
